morvessa.title: High Quartermaster of the Salt Tithe

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Ashbrook's southern gatehouse groans under siege rams as black-cloaked standard-bearers part before the breach.

pre_fight.speaker: morvessa
pre_fight.line: Vaelen bled his levies on your oak doors. I came with ledgers, not battering rams, to collect what Thornwick owes.

pre_fight.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
pre_fight.line: You starved three border parishes before a single arrow flew, Morvessa. Call it taxation if it helps you sleep.

pre_fight.speaker: morvessa
pre_fight.line: Your crown taxed our iron mines dry to gild Thornwick's granaries. A border fence does not cancel a debt.

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: Debts paid in refugees still smell like arson. Step aside from the road.

pre_fight.speaker: morvessa
pre_fight.line: Then watch how neatly an accountant balances a deficit—one severed banner at a time.

phases.line: Every bolt your archers loose was forged from stolen ore. Let us audit the interest.
taunt_barks: Hold the cordon—none pass south!
Your militia fights on empty bellies.
Step forward and sign the writ in blood.

phases.line: So the border dogs still have teeth. Very well—bring forward the cinder-censer.
taunt_barks: Breathe the ash of your own granaries!
Line formations! Do not give an inch!
Garrick's banners are already tinder.

phases.line: You call this victory? You are only buying these people a slower death in Redmarsh.
taunt_barks: My levies will drown you in numbers!
Bleed for a crown that forgot your names!
No retreat—seal the valley mouth!

phases.line: Strike, then. When winter hits the Ford, remember who kept the granaries full.
taunt_barks: I will not die in the mud of Ashbrook!
One last seal—burn them all!
The ledger stays open!

special_callouts.name: Ashen Writ
special_callouts.telegraph_line: By seal and tallow, your ground is forfeit!
special_callouts.hit_line: Marked for collection—feel the ember bite!

special_callouts.name: Cordon of Pikes
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Close ranks! Pin them to the gatehouse stone!

special_callouts.name: Salt-Tax Hex
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Let thirst dry the marrow in your bones!
special_callouts.hit_line: Even your blood belongs to the Crown's creditors!

death_scene.speaker: morvessa
death_scene.line: Look south... past the smoke... Redmarsh is already dry. You saved them for the buzzards...

death_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
death_scene.line: Better buzzards under an open sky than chains in your salt pits, Morvessa.

death_scene.speaker: field-ashbrook-watchman
death_scene.line: The siege line is breaking! Vaelen's remnants are scattering up the ridge!

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Get the wounded onto the wagons before they rally. The road won't stay open long.

death_scene.speaker: narrator
death_scene.line: Her brass abacus clatters into the ash, its beads spilled like cold iron teeth across the muddy road.

morvessa.hero_reaction: She had numbers for every sack of grain and none for the graves behind her.
morvessa.loot_flavor: A heavy brass seal ring warm with residual hex-fire, stamped with the crest of the Border Mint.

gorrathul.title: Warden of the Forked Cisterns

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Above the twin causeways, iron sluice-gates hiss steam over the parched basin of Ironheart Bastion.

pre_fight.speaker: gorrathul
pre_fight.line: Two causeways, two thousand corpses, and still you climb toward my cisterns with dry canteens.

pre_fight.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
pre_fight.line: You dammed the aquifer at the mountain's throat, Gorrathul! Three settlements turned to dust!

pre_fight.speaker: gorrathul
pre_fight.line: Rationed water kept ten thousand alive through the drought. Open the sluices to your mob and everyone dies by autumn.

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: Hoarding water behind catapults isn't stewardship. Open the gates.

pre_fight.speaker: gorrathul
pre_fight.line: If you want the keys to the mountain, pry them from my gauntlets.

phases.line: The stone of Ironheart has broken finer armies than yours on those narrow causeways.
taunt_barks: Test your steel against mountain basalt!
Your thirst makes you sloppy!
Hold the parapet—spill nothing!

phases.line: You breached the outer redoubts. Good. Now bleed where the air is thin.
taunt_barks: Sound the iron bells—crush their flank!
Every step upward costs you a squad!
Neither marsh nor cliff will save you!

phases.line: Fools! Below this bastion lies a dry sea! You are tearing down the only dam left!
taunt_barks: Feel the weight of the forked peak!
My oath is older than your kingdom!
Break upon my shield!

phases.line: Still standing... fine. Take the mountain, and choke on its dust.
taunt_barks: Ironheart does not yield!
To the last breath, to the last stone!
Come and finish it!

special_callouts.name: Basalt Cleave
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Brace your shields—the mountain falls!

special_callouts.name: Scalding Vent
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Open the boiler valves! Cook them in their plate!
special_callouts.hit_line: Steam strips flesh faster than steel!

special_callouts.name: Garrison Volley
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Redoubt crews—range the inner courtyard and fire!

death_scene.speaker: gorrathul
death_scene.line: The lower valves... rusted shut years ago... there was never enough for the valley...

death_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
death_scene.line: Gods above—half these cisterns are empty silt. He was guarding a dry well.

death_scene.speaker: gorrathul
death_scene.line: Fear kept the raiders off the coast road... better they feared my walls than saw the truth...

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Raise the banner on the high parapet. Let the column know the pass is clear.

death_scene.speaker: narrator
death_scene.line: Wind howls through the forked battlements, carrying salt air up from the Iron Coast below.

gorrathul.hero_reaction: He starved a province to protect an empty tank. Men will die for a convincing lie.
gorrathul.loot_flavor: A notched tower-shield core forged from meteoric slag, pitted by forty years of siege-stone.

vesperion.title: Lord Admiral of the Black Blockade

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Burning pitch hisses into black tidewater as the flagship's main deck tilts beneath torn rigging.

pre_fight.speaker: vesperion
pre_fight.line: Admiral Kael bought you time with his life, land-rat, yet you still board a sinking hull.

pre_fight.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
pre_fight.line: You torched Oakhaven's drydocks and sank fishing sloops! There's no honor in harbor arson!

pre_fight.speaker: vesperion
pre_fight.line: Every keel in Harborwatch was built to ferry troops to the Ember Core. I burned ships to save a continent.

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: You burned civilians on wooden piers. The sea doesn't care about your strategy.

pre_fight.speaker: vesperion
pre_fight.line: Then let the tide judge between us before the magazine catches.

phases.line: Mind the slick planks—blood and whale oil turn a good swordsman into ballast.
taunt_barks: Marines! Sweep them into the scuppers!
You fight like men who miss dry dirt!
The tide is against you!

phases.line: Stubborn bastards. Bring the pitch-pots topside—light the forecastle!
taunt_barks: Let the harbor choke on black smoke!
Your sea-wall guns are too late!
Dance on burning oak!

phases.line: You think sailing into the volcanic straits is victory? You are rowing into a furnace!
taunt_barks: Cut the halyards—drop the spars on them!
No quarter on my quarterdeck!
Down with the ship, if we must!

phases.line: The hull is split... take the helm, then, and steer straight into hell.
taunt_barks: One last broadside!
Still standing? Come take my saber!
The deep takes all flags!

special_callouts.name: Grapeshot Sweeper
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Swivel guns—clear the main deck!

special_callouts.name: Pitch Lantern
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Heave the oil casks! Set the bilge alight!

special_callouts.name: Riptide Lunge
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Watch the roll of the swell—now!

death_scene.speaker: vesperion
death_scene.line: Look east... the ash clouds already touch the horizon... I tried to sink the ferryman...

death_scene.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
death_scene.line: The harbor batteries are ours! Cut the mooring lines before her powder blows!

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Over the rail—now. Leave the admiralty to the crabs.

death_scene.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
death_scene.line: Half the fleet is charred timber, captain, but we have hulls enough for the crossing.

death_scene.speaker: narrator
death_scene.line: The flagship settles beneath boiling foam, trailing a slick of gold braid and burning tar.

vesperion.hero_reaction: He burned a harbor to stop an invasion, and only gave us fewer lifeboats for the trip.
vesperion.loot_flavor: A salt-corroded astrolabe whose brass rings still turn smoothly toward the volcanic southern straits.

ashkarath.title: First Warden of the Anchor Seals

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Shattered conduit pillars weep liquid gold across the Obsidian Dais as the last Anchor Seal fractures.

pre_fight.speaker: ashkarath
pre_fight.line: Four provinces burned to bring you to my steps, and now you smash the very chains holding the cinders down.

pre_fight.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
pre_fight.line: The Anchor Seals starved the realm of warmth and grace, Ashkarath! Every harvest failed under your ash!

pre_fight.speaker: ashkarath
pre_fight.line: A cold hearth is still a house. Unbind the primordial fire and you do not rule the world—you become its fuel.

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: Better to burn hot and brief than rot forever in your cellar.

pre_fight.speaker: ashkarath
pre_fight.line: Then step onto the Obsidian Dais, usurper, and prove your flesh can hold a sun.

phases.line: Two conduit pillars lie in ruin, yet enough ember remains in my armor to unmake you.
taunt_barks: Kneel before the old covenant!
Your ambition outstrips your mortal frame!
Feel the weight of the Obsidian Throne!

phases.line: You drink the unbound flame like wine—tell me, does it taste like ashes yet?
taunt_barks: Every spark you steal hollows your soul!
The Wardens held this line for ten reigns!
Your allies already fear what you are becoming!

phases.line: Look at your hands! Even if you strike me down, you can never leave this throne!
taunt_barks: I will seal the breach with your corpse!
Burn, mortal—burn until nothing remains!
The crown of ember is a branding iron!

phases.line: The seals are gone... the fire has chosen its new host... gods pity Thornvael...
taunt_barks: One final stroke for the quiet dark!
Hold fast against the furnace!
So ends the watch!

special_callouts.name: Cinder Edict
special_callouts.telegraph_line: By the broken pillars—let the dais erupt!

special_callouts.name: Warden's Brand
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Bear the mark of the Anchor Seal!

special_callouts.name: Obsidian Judgment
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Rise, slag and sulfur—bury the usurper!

death_scene.speaker: ashkarath
death_scene.line: Sit, then... feel how heavy the quiet becomes when nothing left dares to burn...

death_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
death_scene.line: The volcanic vents are cooling—no, they're bending toward the throne. What have you done?

death_scene.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
death_scene.line: The old penitence is ended. A new lord wears the ember now.

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Tell the banners to stand down. The war is over; the reckoning begins.

death_scene.speaker: narrator
death_scene.line: Ashkarath's empty armor collapses into gray dust as living ember coils silently around the Obsidian Throne.

ashkarath.hero_reaction: He spent centuries guarding a furnace he was too afraid to light. Now the matches are mine.
ashkarath.loot_flavor: A crown-band of blackened meteoric iron, pulsing with a slow, steady heat like a sleeping heart.

elder-juggernaut.title: Primeval Titan of the Highland Cairn

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Pebbles rattle off the fractured granite ridge as an ancient colossus heaves itself upward from a moss-bound cairn.

pre_fight.speaker: npc-kael-huntsman
pre_fight.line: Hold your fire—look at its runes! That colossus isn't serving the Caldera. It's the bedrock itself thrashing in agony as the earth tears apart.

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: Tragic or not, its tremors will collapse Harborwatch's sea-walls before the ships sail. Ready earth-breaking spells.

pre_fight.speaker: elder-juggernaut
pre_fight.line: *A tectonic groan splits the highland granite like thunder, rattling shields and ribs alike.*

phases.line: *Twin granite wardens step forward in lockstep as the colossus raises stone-slab fists.*
taunt_barks: *Stone grinds against stone with the shriek of a falling cliff.*
*Earth fissures spiderweb beneath your boots.*

phases.line: *Incandescent runic fractures flare across its chest as boulders cascade down the ridge.*
taunt_barks: *A deafening stomp sends shockwaves across the highland cairn!*
*Ordinary steel sparks harmlessly off living basalt.*

special_callouts.name: Tectonic Stomp
special_callouts.telegraph_line: *The Elder Juggernaut raises both monolith fists skyward!*

death_scene.speaker: narrator
death_scene.line: With a resonant sigh like settling mountain shale, the Elder Juggernaut's glowing core fractures and dims into dormant gray stone.

death_scene.speaker: npc-kael-huntsman
death_scene.line: Rest easy, old mountain. Look inside the cracked chest—ancient runic coins older than the kingdom.

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Take the bullion for Kors's fleet and march down to the coast. The ridge is quiet.

elder-juggernaut.hero_reaction: Even the stones of Thornvael were screaming against the Caldera. All we could do was grant it silence.
elder-juggernaut.loot_flavor: A palm-sized fragment of resonant highland granite humming softly with primeval earth-wards.

lord-captain-korvus.title: The Iron Anchor, Warlord of the Eastern War Pier

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Volcanic ash falls like hot sleet across Harborwatch's blazing eastern war pier as twin hooked anchors drag sparks across scorched granite.

pre_fight.speaker: lord-captain-korvus
pre_fight.line: Cowards! Running across the sea like rats off a burning hull! If Thornvael must drown in fire, then no one leaves this pier alive!

pre_fight.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
pre_fight.line: They are away! May the salt winds carry them past the Western Rim! Now, Commander—let us show Korvus and his vultures how the rearguard of Thornvael fights!

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: The ships are already beyond your reach, Korvus. The only thing left on this quay is you and my blade.

phases.line: Drag them into the pitch! Anchor their bones!
taunt_barks: Drag them into the pitch! Anchor their bones!
No ship leaves while I hold the quay!
Thornvael burns together!

phases.line: You dare hold the pier against me? Cut the oil-barrels—light the whole eastern jetty!
taunt_barks: Let the harbor choke on black smoke!
Your fleet is sailing into nothing!
Chain-hooks—reel them in!

phases.line: Every coward sails west while the bedrock melts! Fight me on cracked granite, butcher!
taunt_barks: I will anchor your corpses to the sea floor!
No mercy on the war pier!
Die with the continent!

phases.line: The chains... snapping... no—the sails are already clear of the rim...
taunt_barks: One last swing of the Iron Anchor!
Still standing?!
Come down into the surf with me!

special_callouts.name: Hooked Anchor Pull
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Chains whistle through the ash-smoke—brace your footing!
special_callouts.hit_line: Yanked straight into the burning pitch!

special_callouts.name: Quay-Breaker Slam
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Both iron anchors crash down to split the granite pier!

death_scene.speaker: lord-captain-korvus
death_scene.line: The sails... past the horizon... you let them... escape a dying world...

death_scene.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
death_scene.line: The people are safe. Their dawn is on the water. We have bought them their morning—now let us march east into the night.

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Let the black tide take his chains. Muster whoever is left on the quay—we march east at once.

death_scene.speaker: narrator
death_scene.line: Lord-Captain Korvus topples backward into the churning black surf, dragged beneath the waves by the weight of his own twin anchors.

lord-captain-korvus.hero_reaction: He thought tearing down the lifeboats was courage. The people he tried to burn are already beyond his reach.
lord-captain-korvus.loot_flavor: A blackened naval chain-link forged from sea-tempered iron, still warm with harbor pitch.

arch-mage-malrik.title: Grand Conspirator of the Iron Pact

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Violet sparks scar the wind-scoured flagstones of Ashveil Gorge as a hooded sorcerer sprints toward the summit teleportation shrine.

pre_fight.speaker: arch-mage-malrik
pre_fight.line: Sniper-guards, pin them to the switchbacks! One more minute at the summit shrine and Thornvael's ledgers vanish forever!

pre_fight.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
pre_fight.line: He sold the northern border ciphers to the Iron Pact! Cut him off before he reaches the shrine!

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: Box him in on the summit stone. Take those ledgers alive or dead.

phases.line: You chased a ghost across four provinces only to die on a mountain switchback!
taunt_barks: Snipers—cover my retreat!
The Iron Pact pays in obsidian, not copper!
Stay back from the shrine!

phases.line: No! The teleport circle is three paces away—burn them to cinders!
taunt_barks: You cannot read the ledger you bled for!
Shield me, fools!
I will not die on this ridge!

special_callouts.name: Cipher Bolt
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Malrik weaves violet static around the summit shrine!

death_scene.speaker: arch-mage-malrik
death_scene.line: The satchel... keep your hands off... the Pact will burn the vault before...

death_scene.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
death_scene.line: Here are the Royal Cipher-Keys and the Iron Pact Ledger! Look—Morvessa's Salt Tithe was meant for the Order Seals before Malrik diverted the treasury here!

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Then every dead villager in Thornwick died for this traitor's ink. Burn his shrine and move out.

arch-mage-malrik.hero_reaction: From the Border Mint to the Caldera, every betrayal wore a neat ledger and a clean cloak.
arch-mage-malrik.loot_flavor: A scorched leather cipher-satchel stamped with both the Southern Crown and the Iron Pact.

arch-warden-korrath.title: The Living Law, Eternal Sentinel of the Crown Vault

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Inside the frozen marble cathedral of the Crown Vault, dust hangs motionless in pale azure light before a towering sentinel of living granite.

pre_fight.speaker: arch-warden-korrath
pre_fight.line: Three centuries I have stood in granite silence to hold chaos at bay. You shatter anchors and call it mercy, yet without iron law, mortals are only dust in the wind!

pre_fight.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
pre_fight.line: Sunder the West and East Resonance Anchors with the Sigil of Order! While those conduits sing, his granite plate is invulnerable!

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: A frozen world isn't peace, Korrath—it's a tomb! Let Thornvael breathe again, even if it has to bleed to learn!

phases.line: Be still! Turn to stone!
taunt_barks: Be still! Turn to stone!
Hold the phalanx, retainers!
Kneel before eternal stillness!

phases.line: Both anchors sundered... very well. Taste the twin blades of Petrified Judgment!
taunt_barks: Feel stasis creep into your limbs!
Every heartbeat is disobedience!
Become stone beside me!

phases.line: If you snap the necrotic tether, the world will stumble, bleed, and war again! Why save a broken race?!
taunt_barks: Order demands absolute silence!
My granite has outlasted ten kings!
Freeze where you stand!

phases.line: Fractures... in the white stone... after three hundred years...
taunt_barks: Law... cannot... fall...
One final judgment!
Stand still!

special_callouts.name: Petrifying Stasis
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Twin white-granite greatswords chime with freezing azure frost!
special_callouts.hit_line: Stone creeps up your greaves—cleanse the stasis!

special_callouts.name: Judgment of the Vault
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Korrath sweeps a shockwave of frozen marble across the nave!
special_callouts.hit_line: Crushed under three centuries of law!

death_scene.speaker: arch-warden-korrath
death_scene.line: The empire was peace... without stone... you are only... dust...

death_scene.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
death_scene.line: The necrotic tether is snapped! Feel that cold mountain air rushing in—the Caldera is cooling into harmless basalt!

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Let it cool. And let the fleet come home to a world that gets to choose its own dawn.

death_scene.speaker: narrator
death_scene.line: Golden-blue light pours through Korrath's splitting breastplate as the ancient sentinel dissolves into quiet gray dust.

arch-warden-korrath.hero_reaction: He turned himself to stone so he would never watch another city fall. Peace isn't a tomb.
arch-warden-korrath.loot_flavor: A shard of pale marble etched with the Sigil of Order, cool to the touch and faintly humming.

ember-overlord-vorak.title: The Living Kiln, Overlord of the Furnace Heart

pre_fight.speaker: narrator
pre_fight.line: Blinding orange magma churns beneath an obsidian altar as a colossal armored warlord rises before the screaming Crown of Thorns and Cinder.

pre_fight.speaker: ember-overlord-vorak
pre_fight.line: Look upon the kiln, little borderer! Your cities are slag, your treaties are dry paper—only fire reveals what deserves to endure! Step into the magma and prove your worth!

pre_fight.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
pre_fight.line: Break the West and East Obsidian Conduit Pillars feeding his throne! Sever his molten regeneration before he turns the caldera into an open crematorium!

pre_fight.speaker: hero
pre_fight.line: I watched tax collectors starve the North and titans guard empty wells. Never again, Vorak—if fire is the only law this world respects, then I will hold the flame myself!

phases.line: Melt! Burn away the weakness!
taunt_barks: Melt! Burn away the weakness!
Step into the kiln!
My magma never cools!

phases.line: Both pylons shattered?! Good! Watch black iron liquefy into white-hot wrath!
taunt_barks: Let the cavern ceiling rain meteors!
Run across the molten rock!
Feel the Great Cleansing!

phases.line: You do not fight to cool the mountain—I see that hunger in your eyes! You want the Crown!
taunt_barks: Try to lift fire with mortal hands!
Burn until only iron remains!
The Furnace Heart answers strength alone!

phases.line: My helm... cracking in the slag... take it, then, conqueror...
taunt_barks: One last eruption!
Let the caldera swallow us both!
Prove your will!

special_callouts.name: Meteor Rain
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Vorak roars skyward as incandescent magma boulders tear loose from the cavern dome!

special_callouts.name: Slag Wave
special_callouts.telegraph_line: Vorak cleaves the flagstones, sending a rolling tide of liquid rock across the arena!
special_callouts.hit_line: Scorched to the bone by molten slag!

death_scene.speaker: ember-overlord-vorak
death_scene.line: Burn, then... conqueror... take the Crown... and see if it does not melt your bones as it melted mine...

death_scene.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
death_scene.line: The magma vents aren't cooling—they're bending toward the altar! What are you doing with that Crown?!

death_scene.speaker: hero
death_scene.line: Never again will tax collectors starve the North or cities burn on a pier. Every border in Thornvael answers to iron and ember now.

death_scene.speaker: narrator
death_scene.line: Vorak topples backward into the glowing fissure as the hero lifts the blazing Crown of Thorns and Cinder onto brow and bone.

ember-overlord-vorak.hero_reaction: Vorak wanted to melt the world into nothing. I will forge it into something no storm can ever break.
ember-overlord-vorak.loot_flavor: The Crown of Thorns and Cinder—blackened meteoric iron fused with living volcanic fire.
